## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run audit:public`
- [ ] `npm run audit:strict`
- [ ] `npm run sonar` passed with the versioned strict quality gate.
- [ ] The **Strict quality gate** CI check passed for the latest commit.

## AI assistance and review

AI tools used (or `none`):

Accountable human reviewer:

- [ ] A human checked the implementation against the requirements and existing architecture.
- [ ] Tests independently cover expected behavior, failure paths, authorization, and workspace isolation where relevant.
- [ ] Added dependencies and APIs exist; provenance, maintenance, and licenses were reviewed.
- [ ] Tests, coverage, security checks, and quality thresholds were not weakened to obtain a passing result.
- [ ] Security findings and any claimed false positives have concrete review evidence.

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, private financial data, or local environment files are included.
- [ ] Financial mutations remain workspace-scoped and idempotent.
- [ ] UI changes were checked on mobile and desktop where applicable.
